title: How he got the nickname Sunshine
summary: Froeberg called him Sunshine in Memphis and the name stuck in New York; he was listed as Jack Sunshine on a record.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: And Johnny Russell played tenor. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. And how come they called you Sunshine?

Oh man that's a long story. Froeberg tacked that name on me. We were playing in Memphis in the Peabody Hotel and we were going up to the roof to play a session, a luncheon session or something and I don't know, he started talking like a colored guy, you know, and he said something about Sunshine, called me Sunshine, and the guy named his stuff, he just kept on calling me Sunshine for some reason, I don't know. I got to New York and he'd say, meet Sunshine, my real name. And a lot of guys in the world didn't even know my real name. I knew a lot of people up there but none of them knew my real name.
Well they have you listed on the Metro record as Jack Sunshine. Jack Sunshine. Can you imagine? Yeah. Everybody thought that was you in there. Clayton Doyle comes out of Jackson. That's right.
Froeberg caught that. Couldn't get away from him when I got up there.
